correctness.rationale: Radial monomial orthogonality yields lambda_k as the ratio of t^(k+d-1) exp[-c/(1-t)^gamma] integrals with multiplicity binom(k+d-1,d-1). Strict likelihood-ratio ordering gives lambda_(k+1)<lambda_k and trace class follows exponential damping at fixed epsilon. Set y=-log(t): U(y)=c(1-e^-y)^-gamma is strictly convex; -U'(y_epsilon) and U''(y_epsilon) are precisely L+d and Q². Laplace expansion in units 1/Q converges to N(-u,1), while exponential tilting outside the O(Q) window controls the infinite degree tails. Multiplicity-weighted Riemann sum of Phi(u)Phi(-u) integrates to 1/sqrt(pi). Independently checked nine local Gaussian window values with separate log-coordinate quadrature. No finite test establishes global tail summability.
